head_commit.message:
Align search metrics logging with adapter-layer pattern

Move max_score, total_relation, and aggregation overflow logging from the service layer (newrelic.agent + logger.info) to the adapter layer using add_extra_data_to_current_request_logs, matching the pattern established for took_ms, timed_out, and shards_failed.

Replace agency-specific sum_other_doc_count with generic agg_overflow dict that captures overflow for all aggregations, logged as search.agg_overflow.<name>. Keep scoring_rule in the service layer as it derives from search params, not the OpenSearch response.

head_commit.message:
[Issue #8599] Build edit opportunity page for grantor draft editing

Adds the frontend edit opportunity page at /opportunity/[id]/edit, enabling
grantors to fill in and save draft summary details (funding, eligibility, dates,
contact info) for opportunities they created.

Key changes:
- New edit page (page.tsx) that fetches opportunity data, guards non-draft access,
  and wires up initial values from the existing forecast or non-forecast summary
- Server action (actions.ts) that validates the form with Zod, POSTs a new summary
  on the first save (when no summary exists yet) and PUTs on subsequent saves
- OpportunityEditForm component with all camelCase name= attributes, hidden inputs
  for title/awardSelectionMethod, useActionState + startTransition for React 19
  compatibility, and disabled field state for non-draft opportunities
- opportunityEditFormConfig.ts with buildOpportunitySummaryUpdateRequest helper
  and enum option lists
- opportunitySummaryGrantorFetcher.ts for create/update summary API calls
- Redirect from create opportunity form to /opportunity/[id]/edit on success
- i18n strings for all OpportunityEdit labels, hints, alerts, and validation errors
- Full test coverage for the server action and the form component

[ISSUE #8517]: Implement saved to organization tags for saved opportunity card (#9306)

## Summary

Fixes / Work for #8517  

This PR updates saved opportunity cards to display contextual saved-to
tags instead of the previous generic saved indicator.

## Changes proposed

### What changed

- removed the generic Saved tag from saved opportunity cards
- added an Individual tag for opportunities saved to the user’s own list
- added organization tags for `saved_to_organizations`
- ensured organization tags render alphabetically after Individual
- updated saved opportunity state after organization changes in the
share modal
- added mobile-friendly horizontal scrolling for the saved-to tag list
- updated opportunity types to include organization_name for saved
organizations
- added focused unit tests for `saved-opportunity` tag building,
rendering, and controller state updates

## Context for reviewers

- this PR keeps layout changes intentionally scoped to this feature
- larger semantic/card-structure refinements will be handled in a
follow-up ticket

## Validation steps

### Test steps

- [x] Go to the Saved Opportunities page.
- [x] Confirm the previous generic Saved tag no longer appears on saved
opportunity cards.
- Confirm a saved opportunity with no organizations shows:
  - sign in as 'test'
  - [x] Individual
- Confirm a saved opportunity with one or more organizations shows:
  - sign in as "two_org_user"
  - [x] Individual first
  - [x] organization tags after it in alphabetical order
- [x] Open the Share with organization modal for a saved opportunity.
- [x] Add an organization and close the modal.
- [x] Confirm the card updates to show the new organization tag.
- [x] Remove an organization and close the modal.
- [x] Confirm the card updates to remove that organization tag.
- [x] Confirm saved-to tags appear only on saved opportunity cards.

Responsive

- [x] View the Saved Opportunities page on a mobile viewport.
- [x] Confirm the saved-to tag list scrolls horizontally.
- [x] Confirm long organization names remain accessible via horizontal
scrolling.
- [x] View the page on tablet and desktop.
- [x] Confirm tags wrap normally and the mobile fade affordance is no
longer shown.

Accessibility

- [x] Confirm the saved-to label is associated correctly with the tag
list.
- [x] Confirm screen readers announce:
- [x] Saved to your list for the Individual tag
- [x] Shared with <Organization Name> for organization tags

## Summary

Fixes / Work for #8517  

This PR updates saved opportunity cards to display contextual saved-to
tags instead of the previous generic saved indicator.

## Changes proposed

### What changed

- removed the generic Saved tag from saved opportunity cards
- added an Individual tag for opportunities saved to the user’s own list
- added organization tags for `saved_to_organizations`
- ensured organization tags render alphabetically after Individual
- updated saved opportunity state after organization changes in the
share modal
- added mobile-friendly horizontal scrolling for the saved-to tag list
- updated opportunity types to include organization_name for saved
organizations
- added focused unit tests for `saved-opportunity` tag building,
rendering, and controller state updates

- this PR keeps layout changes intentionally scoped to this feature
- larger semantic/card-structure refinements will be handled in a
follow-up ticket

opportunity cards.

- Confirm a saved opportunity with one or more organizations shows:
  - sign in as "two_org_user"
  - [x] Individual first
  - [x] organization tags after it in alphabetical order
- [x] Open the Share with organization modal for a saved opportunity.
- [x] Add an organization and close the modal.
- [x] Confirm the card updates to show the new organization tag.
- [x] Remove an organization and close the modal.
- [x] Confirm the card updates to remove that organization tag.
- [x] Confirm saved-to tags appear only on saved opportunity cards.

Responsive

- [x] View the Saved Opportunities page on a mobile viewport.
- [x] Confirm the saved-to tag list scrolls horizontally.
- [x] Confirm long organization names remain accessible via horizontal
scrolling.
- [x] View the page on tablet and desktop.
- [x] Confirm tags wrap normally and the mobile fade affordance is no
longer shown.

Accessibility

- [x] Confirm the saved-to label is associated correctly with the tag
list.

- [x] Saved to your list for the Individual tag
- [x] Shared with <Organization Name> for organization tags

[Issue #8969] Ensure save opportunity icon works as expected (#9299)

## Summary

<!-- Use "Fixes" to automatically close issue upon PR merge. Use "Work
for" when UAT is required. -->
Fixes / Work for #8969 

## Changes proposed

This pr adds logic for ensuring that the save opportunity icon on the
search results and opportunity detail page correctly reflects the saved
status against the users individually saved opportunities.

This pr also includes methods for determining the scope of the request
based on organization_id and scope params. It will only return the
default until filters are supported.

## Context for reviewers

Prior to this change, the saved opportunity icon was checking if the
opportunity was saved against the "all" scope of saved opportunity
instead of the "individual" scope saved opportunities response. This
updates those checks to check against the individual saved
opportunities.

## Validation steps

1. Ensure db is seeded by running `make db-seed-local`
2. Find the `isShareWithOrganizationEnabled` and set it to true and run
the api and frontend
3. Login as two_org_user
4. Navigate to workspaces > organizations and ensure you have 2
organizations listed
5. Navigate to the saved opportunities page and assert there are not
saved opportunities
6. Navigate to the search page and save 2 opportunities by clicking the
star icon
7. Navigate to the saved opportunities page and verify 2 saved
opportunities
8. On one saved opportunity listing, click on the title to navigate to
the opportunity detail view.
9. Verify the saved icon correctly reflects the saved status (yellow)
10. Click to un-save the opportunity and navigate back to the saved
opportunities page. Refresh and verify the opportunity is no longer
there
11. On the other saved opportunity, click on the "Share with
organization" to open the modal and select one of the organizations to
save the opportunity to.
12. Now click on that opportunity title to navigate to the opportunity
detail page.
13. Verify the saved icon correctly reflects the saved status (yellow)
14. Click the star icon to un-save it and navigate back to the saved
opportunities page.
15. Verify you still see the opportunity in the saved opportunity list
and verify there is a checked organization in the share modal.
16. Navigate to the search page to find the opportunity in the search
results and verify the saved icon does not indicate it is saved
17. Go back to the saved opportunities page and uncheck the organization
in the modal and verify the saved opportunity page renders empty

[Issue #8969] Ensure save opportunity icon works as expected (#9299)

## Summary

<!-- Use "Fixes" to automatically close issue upon PR merge. Use "Work
for" when UAT is required. -->
Fixes / Work for #8969 

## Changes proposed

This pr adds logic for ensuring that the save opportunity icon on the
search results and opportunity detail page correctly reflects the saved
status against the users individually saved opportunities.

This pr also includes methods for determining the scope of the request
based on organization_id and scope params. It will only return the
default until filters are supported.

## Context for reviewers

Prior to this change, the saved opportunity icon was checking if the
opportunity was saved against the "all" scope of saved opportunity
instead of the "individual" scope saved opportunities response. This
updates those checks to check against the individual saved
opportunities.

## Validation steps

1. Ensure db is seeded by running `make db-seed-local`
2. Find the `isShareWithOrganizationEnabled` and set it to true and run
the api and frontend
3. Login as two_org_user
4. Navigate to workspaces > organizations and ensure you have 2
organizations listed
5. Navigate to the saved opportunities page and assert there are not
saved opportunities
6. Navigate to the search page and save 2 opportunities by clicking the
star icon
7. Navigate to the saved opportunities page and verify 2 saved
opportunities
8. On one saved opportunity listing, click on the title to navigate to
the opportunity detail view.
9. Verify the saved icon correctly reflects the saved status (yellow)
10. Click to un-save the opportunity and navigate back to the saved
opportunities page. Refresh and verify the opportunity is no longer
there
11. On the other saved opportunity, click on the "Share with
organization" to open the modal and select one of the organizations to
save the opportunity to.
12. Now click on that opportunity title to navigate to the opportunity
detail page.
13. Verify the saved icon correctly reflects the saved status (yellow)
14. Click the star icon to un-save it and navigate back to the saved
opportunities page.
15. Verify you still see the opportunity in the saved opportunity list
and verify there is a checked organization in the share modal.
16. Navigate to the search page to find the opportunity in the search
results and verify the saved icon does not indicate it is saved
17. Go back to the saved opportunities page and uncheck the organization
in the modal and verify the saved opportunity page renders empty

## Summary

<!-- Use "Fixes" to automatically close issue upon PR merge. Use "Work
for" when UAT is required. -->
Fixes / Work for #7725  

## Changes proposed

- Updated page.tsx to gate the `dev/feature-flags` page
- Updated robots.ts to add `/dev/feature-flags` to the production
disallow list
- Updated deafultFeatureFlags.ts to add `featureFlagAdminOff` feature
flag with default of false
- Updated environments.ts to add `FEATURE_FEATURE_FLAG_ADMIN_OFF` to
environment variable mapping
- Updated environemnt_variables.tf to add the SSM parameter store
configuration for `FEATURE_FEATURE_FLAG_ADMIN_OFF`
- Updated page.test.tsx to accout for feature flag changes in tests

## Context for reviewers

The feature flag admin page at `/dev/feature-flags` is currently
publicly visible and crawlable in production. We want to make it more
protected so that users don't stumble on it accidentally and get
confused.

**Note:** After merge, the SSM parameter
`/frontend/prod/feature-feature-flag-admin-off` needs to be created with
value "true" in production (and "false" or left unset in other
environments) before deploying.

## Validation steps

1. Run the frontend locally
2. Navigate to http://localhost:3000/dev/feature-flags - the page should
load normally as the flag defaults to false
3. Navigate to
http://localhost:3000/dev/feature-flags?_ff=featureFlagAdminOff:true -
the page should return a 404 (you should see "Oops, we can't find that
page")

[Issue #7723] Create a maintenance flag to disable the site in cases of emergency (#9234)

## Summary

<!-- Use "Fixes" to automatically close issue upon PR merge. Use "Work
for" when UAT is required. -->
Fixes / Work for #7723  

## Changes proposed

- Updated defaultFeatureFlags.ts to remove `opportunitiesListOff: false`
and add `maintenanceMode: false`
- Updated environments.ts to add `FEATURE_MAINTENANCE_MODE` and mapping
and remove `FEATURE_OPPORTUNITIES_LIST_OFF` and mapping
- Updated proxy.ts to add maintenance mode check in the middleware. When
`maintenanceMode` is enabled, all non-API, non-maintenance-page requests
are redirected to `/maintenance`
- Updated environment_variables.tf to add `FEATURE_MAINTENANCE_MODE`
environment variable and remove `FEATURE_SEARCH_DRAWER_ON` and
`FEATURE_SEARCH_TABLE_ON` environment variables
- Updated /opportunities/page.tsx to remove `withFeatureFlag` wrapper as
the middleware now handles this instead
- Updated /opportunities/page.test.tsx to account for the removal of
`withFeatureFlag`
- Updated providerMocks.tsx to removed `opportunitiesListOff` from mock
feature flags

## Context for reviewers

We wanted to create a way to turn off the site in case of emergency.
This creates a feature flag that will redirect all pages to the
maintenance page by changing the flag in SSM.

**Note:** The new SSM parameter will need to be created and set to
"false" in all environments:
`/frontend/${var.environment}/feature-maintenance-mode`.

The following SSM parameters can be removed:
- `/frontend/${var.environment}/feature-search-table-on`
- `/frontend/${var.environment}/feature-search-drawer-on`

## Validation steps

1. Run the frontend locally. You should be able to navigate to every
page as normal.
2. To enable maintenance mode (i.e. setting the flag to true), navigate
to this url: http://localhost:3000?_ff=maintenanceMode:true
3. You will be redirected to the maintenance page. Navigating to any
other page will similarly redirect to this same maintenance page.
4. To disable maintenance mode, navigate to this url:
http://localhost:3000?_ff=maintenanceMode:false
5. You will be redirected to the home page and can now freely navigate
to any page on the site as normal.
